pr_title: Disallowed Save Map without Title and Author Input
pr_body:
Fixes #20236

When trying to save a map it is possible to do so without specifying a Title or Author. Previously, the only enforced requirement was a filename, which has been expanded to enforce both a title and author be entered prior to saving the map.

Apologies to PunkPun and abcdefg30 - I had to resubmit this to keep branches in order (I'm a newbie).  I incorporated abcdefg30's changes to not include white space as well.
pr_comments: As long as we're improving this, would it also be nice to check to see if a user had edited the Title and Author sections from the default "Name your map here" and "Your name here"?  If they haven't, perhaps the save button is allowed given that there is text input, technically, but on press it refocuses to the Title or Author window and highlights text for change?

> As long as we're improving this, would it also be nice to check to see if a user had edited the Title and Author sections from the default "Name your map here" and "Your name here"? If they haven't, perhaps the save button is allowed given that there is text input, technically, but on press it refocuses to the Title or Author window and highlights text for change?

You mean to focus the title or author if they still have the default values?

> > As long as we're improving this, would it also be nice to check to see if a user had edited the Title and Author sections from the default "Name your map here" and "Your name here"? If they haven't, perhaps the save button is allowed given that there is text input, technically, but on press it refocuses to the Title or Author window and highlights text for change?
> 
> You mean to focus the title or author if they still have the default values?

But also highlight the text to make it clear what is happening.

Imho the best idea would be to have `Your name here` and `Name your map here` grey text that is not "real" text, like the `Leave a comment` text on GitHub before you wrote anything:
![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7704140/189368476-0f89d531-9971-459f-98db-14d509d7d11b.png)

Yeah, placeholders would be great. Anything that improves UX with forms. But let's keep this PR simple - I think it's a nice polish win. And then have a larger conversation around forms and validation.

> @The-Zen-Cat Please clean-up the commit message as it has the same line repeated several times. Otherwise changes LGTM and the feature works 👍

Sorry, not sure how to do this?  It seems like squashing commits together creates duplicate commit messages?
Ok, I think the commit --amend worked.  There should now be only 1 commit message.  Added newline after if statement.

The game won't stop you from saving a map without a name or an author.

## Reproduction
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1355810/187448684-87de87fb-8161-45de-a56f-e4bf99ce3b53.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1355810/187449025-e6daba68-c3ac-4c30-ac4e-3dfaf2e74856.png)

## Expected behavior
The game should disable the "Save" button or display a prompt.
